digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 23 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, Rust, TypeScript）和 13 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「其他热门」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo
repos.description: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
repos.summary_zh: 输入主题或关键词，AI 自动完成文案、配音、剪辑全流程，零门槛生成高清短视频

repos.name: openai/codex
repos.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
repos.summary_zh: 终端里跑的轻量级编码代理，用 Rust 写成，让 AI 直接在命令行完成编程任务

repos.name: usestrix/strix
repos.description: Open-source AI penetration testing tool to find and fix your app’s vulnerabilities.
repos.summary_zh: 开源AI渗透测试工具，自动发现并修复应用漏洞，让安全审计像聊天一样简单

repos.name: volcengine/OpenViking
repos.description: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG and Skills.
repos.summary_zh: 自进化上下文数据库，统一 Agent 记忆、RAG 知识与技能，让 AI 持续学习成长

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.description: 🕷️ An adaptive Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl!
repos.summary_zh: 自适应爬虫框架，从单请求到全站抓取全包，动态反检测与智能解析是最大亮点

repos.name: index-tts/index-tts

repos.name: RyanCodrai/turbovec

repos.name: quickwit-oss/tantivy
repos.description: Tantivy is a full-text search engine library inspired by Apache Lucene and written in Rust
repos.summary_zh: Rust 重写的全文搜索引擎库，比 Lucene 内存占用低数倍且性能相当，适合高并发检索场景

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施

repos.summary_zh: 苹果芯片上跑 LLM 推理的菜单栏神器，连续批处理加 SSD 缓存大幅提速

repos.description: Fine-tune LLMs from one YAML. Layer streaming trains an 8B model on a 4 GB laptop GPU.
repos.summary_zh: 一份 YAML 配置即可微调大模型，流式分层训练让 8B 模型跑在 4GB 显存笔记本上

repos.description: MMOOC: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Out-of-Context Evaluation in Multimodal Large Language Models
repos.summary_zh: 首个多模态大模型脱离上下文评测基准，专测模型在信息缺失或矛盾场景下的推理鲁棒性

repos.summary_zh: 隐私优先的简历生成器，全开源可自托管，模板自由定制且永久免费，数据完全由你掌控

repos.name: longbridge/gpui-component
repos.description: Rust GUI components for building fantastic cross-platform desktop application by using GPUI.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 和 GPUI 构建跨平台桌面应用的组件库，让界面开发像搭积木一样高效

repos.name: lightningpixel/modly
repos.description: Desktop app to generate 3D models from images or prompt using local AI — runs entirely on your GPU
repos.summary_zh: 本地 GPU 跑通文生 3D 模型，无需云端即可把图片或提示词变成可编辑模型

repos.name: youssofal/MTPLX
repos.description: 3x faster speeds on MLX | Qwen 3.8 27B | Native MTP Speculative Decoding On Apple Silicon With No External Drafter.
repos.summary_zh: MLX 上原生投机解码提速 3 倍，Qwen 3 27B 无需外部草稿模型即可在 Apple Silicon 上加速推理

repos.description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
repos.summary_zh: Atom 与 Tree-sitter 团队打造的多人协作编辑器，用 Rust 实现极速响应与实时共享编码体验

repos.description: A full-featured download manager.

repos.summary_zh: 一条命令测试数百模型与供应商，秒查你的硬件能跑哪些大模型

papers.title: $TCP_α$: Margin-Controlled Confidence estimation for reliable Music Information Retrieval

papers.abstract: The BrowseComp-Plus benchmark disentangled the evaluation of agentic search by replacing opaque web search with a fixed corpus, so that an agent's role can be separated from the retriever's. That corp

papers.title: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement

papers.abstract: Despite their growing importance for contact-free radio frequency (RF) based healthcare monitoring, different radio technologies such as frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) radar, impulse radio
